_meta.description: Build cmp_signatures.json for the Study 3 crawler.

evidence_levels.code: seen in downloaded vendor JS or live storefront HTML
evidence_levels.unverified: not verified here; confirm in the manual audit

integration_modes.A: CPAPI only (setTrackingConsent on choice; no main-thread blocker)
integration_modes.B: main-thread script blocker only (never writes CPAPI; cannot gate sandboxed web pixels)

generic_reject.text_regex: ^\s*(reject( all)?( cookies| optional cookies)?|decline( all)?( optional( cookies)?)?|deny( all)?( non[- ]essential)?|refuse( all)?|disagree|i decline|no,? thanks|(strictly )?necessary( cookies)? only|use (only )?(strictly )?necessary( cookies)?( only)?|only (necessary|essential|required)( cookies)?|required only|continue without (accepting|agreeing))\s*$
procedure: wait until a known CMP container or the generic banner detector is visible (<=10 s)
search visible buttons/links (piercing open shadow roots) inside the container; take the first whose trimmed text fully matches text_regex, else a CMP-specific selector
never click an element whose text matches never_click_regex; never follow "Do Not Sell/Share" links or submit forms
if no reject-type control exists, record reject_available=false and do not click anything
screenshot before/after; record click time, selector/text used, and Shopify.customerPrivacy.currentVisitorConsent() 1 s and 5 s after the click

per_store_integration_test.definition: A store is CPAPI-integrated (observed) if, after the Decline click, Shopify.customerPrivacy.currentVisitorConsent().marketing becomes "no" (or a visitorConsentCollected event with marketingAllowed=false fires) within 5 s; otherwise the CMP is script-blocking-only on that store (observed mode B) even if the product supports CPAPI.

shopify_consent_readout.js_methods_source: exports of /cdn/shopifycloud/consent-tracking-api/v0.1/consent-tracking-api.js (static_mechanism/consent_tracking_api.pretty.js); also deprecated aliases userCanBeTracked, userDataCanBeSold, firstPartyMarketingAllowed, thirdPartyMarketingAllowed, setCCPAConsent, getCCPAConsent
shopify_consent_readout.event: document "visitorConsentCollected" CustomEvent, detail {analyticsAllowed, marketingAllowed, preferencesAllowed, saleOfDataAllowed}

server_timing.decode: choices: lower-case letter = declined, upper-case = accepted, absent = no choice; purposes: upper-case letter present = processing allowed (A analytics, M marketing, P preferences, S sale of data)

no choice; all allowed (opt-out mode); no banner required
no choice; analytics/marketing/preferences NOT allowed until consent (opt-in mode); banner required
Sec-GPC: 1 sent -> sale_of_data declined, S removed

shopify_consent_readout.web_pixels_config: inline <script> calling wpmLoader({... webPixelsConfigList: [...] ...}); parse the JSON array between "webPixelsConfigList:" and ", isMerchantRequest" (fields id, type APP|CUSTOM, runtimeContext STRICT|LAX|OPEN, apiClientId, privacyPurposes, configuration)
edge_cache_flags: response header cf-cache-status: HIT with large age
_cmp region differs from the vantage region -> consent header cached from another visitor
